builds.name: Heavy Armor/Epic Armor
builds.summary: Safer, better survivability. You mostly play around your horse — use Right Click into horse turn and attack to optimize damage, and you can move your camera during Right Click to extend the swing and hit more targets. Once dismounted, Shift-AA into block cancels the animation and immediately goes into another Shift-AA for quick, repeated hits. When fully committing on foot, the ideal combo is Warlord's Greeting → Flying Reaper (ult) → Shift-AA chain.

builds.name: Medium Armour
builds.summary: High damage, relies on proper spell use for defense. Focused on full Strength and medium armor to amplify blunt damage (especially effective with event sets like Season 6's, which allow stacking blunt bonuses). Relies on immense Turn and Attack & Right Click DMG on horse, Flying Reaper for burst and control on ground, and Heat of Battle to cancel enemy spells and survive pressure. Playstyle centers around horse mobility: Right Click into a horse turn and camera drag to extend swing range and poke from safety. Once dismounted, Shift-AA into block cancels the animation, allowing chaining of multiple Shift-AAs for burst.

techniques.rhythm: During Turn and Attack, damage taken is reduced by 30%; each enemy hit reduces the skill's own cooldown by 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 20 seconds — per the 2025-06-04 balance-notes image.

techniques.name: Shift-AA into block (animation cancel)
steps: into block to cancel the animation
techniques.rhythm: Cancels the animation for quick, repeated hits once dismounted; lets you chain multiple Shift-AAs for burst.

techniques.name: Full-commitment ground combo
techniques.rhythm: The ideal combo when fully committing on foot.

gameplay.text: Glaive is a mounted-focused hero with high burst and team utility. Due to nerfs to foot-based skills, it rely less on being a burst class on foot. It excels as a mounted brawler and team buffer. You play around Turn & Attack, horse auto-attacks, and once on ground: buffs + burst, then disengage.
Learning how to space, what spell can you cancel with heat of battle, and to be pro-active while not losing horse will be key to being useful as glaive!
